findings.desc: CHK-002:edge and CHK-004:edge verificationEvidence claim the story diff excludes unrelated root/docs/code changes, but the recorded command is `git diff --name-status main...HEAD -- scoped docs`, which path-filters to docs and therefore cannot prove absence of non-doc or root-level changes. A full unfiltered diff or explicit negative path check is needed as checklist verificationEvidence for the docs-only scope claim.
findings.resolvedReason: Refreshed CHK-002:edge and CHK-004:edge verificationEvidence to use an unfiltered git diff --name-status main...HEAD plus an allowlist negative path check. The check produced no output and exited 0, proving only B-3a80 Lattice metadata and the three scoped docs are present; path-filtered evidence is no longer relied on.
